name: Koibana Days
source:
——When she was young, the heroine, Misaki Hana, heard of a wonderful legend from her grandfather.

“In my days, I have managed to make bloom, the legendary flower. The legendary flower is a flower that connects the hearts of people. And I believe, you’re able to make this flower bloom as well.”

Since then, she has come to love flowers. And in the second year of high school, she returns to the town she used to live in with her grandfather. In this town, there is the Suzunomori Academy, which specializes in gardening courses. Considering she loves flowers…. She decided to transfer into that school.

And on the first day of transfer,  guided by the gorgeous and sexy sisters (?!) directors of the school, she received a mysterious seed.

“Please grow this seed with care. And then, grow a flower of youth that is yours only, and take part in the Flower Show!”——

The game starts in April of the school year, and lasts throughout the period of one year. The play-through is split into two parts, ‘Adventure Part’ depicts the school life and the various events that take place depending on the timing. ‘Gardening Part’ takes place after school and in your own yard. How you decide to grow your flowers is up to you, but depending on which, the corresponding love meters of the boys will rise. And then, the Flower Show at the end of the school year in March; the Grand Prix. To win, you need high points in skills, knowledge and love!

[Taken from [url=http://konnistique.tumblr.com/post/34848542807/koibana-days-pure-flower-garden-otomate-otome]konnistique's Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
——年轻时，女主角美咲花从祖父那里听说了一个美妙的传说。

“在我的时代，我曾让传奇之花绽放。传奇之花是连接人心的花。我相信，你也能让这朵花绽放。”

从此，她就爱上了花。高二的时候，她回到了曾经和祖父一起居住的小镇。在这个小镇上，有专门教授园艺课程的铃之森学院。考虑到她喜欢花……她决定转学到那所学校。

而转学第一天，在华丽性感的学园长姐妹们（？！）的引导下，她收到了一颗神秘的种子。

“请用心培育这颗种子，然后，培育出一朵只属于你的青春之花，参加花展！”——

比赛从学年四月开始，持续一年。游戏分为两部分，“冒险部分”描述了学校生活以及根据时间发生的各种事件。“园艺部分”在放学后在你自己的院子里进行。你决定如何种植你的花朵取决于你，但根据不同的情况，男孩们相应的爱情指数将会上升。然后是三月份学年末的花展；大奖赛。为了获胜，你需要高分的技能、知识和爱心！

[摘自 [url=http://konnistique.tumblr.com/post/34848542807/koibana-days-pure-flower-garden-otomate-otome]konnistique的Tumblr[/url]]
